problem: Add `hlx goals` CLI command namespace (create, list, get, terminate) to helix-cli, calling existing server API endpoints at /api/goals. Goals are a separate entity from tickets and must NOT modify VALID_MODES or any ticket commands.

files.why: Main entry point where the `goals` command case must be added to the switch statement (follows pattern of `tickets`, `comments`, etc. at lines 80-145). Must import `runGoals` and register a new case.
Reference pattern for namespace router implementation. Shows subcommand dispatch via switch, help text printing, and how `configOrHelp` is passed through. 150 lines.
Reference pattern for create command (flag parsing, repo resolution, API POST, structured output). Contains VALID_MODES at line 13 which must NOT be modified (stays at 5 values). 185 lines.
Reference pattern for list command (query params, client-side filtering, table and JSON output). 115 lines.
Reference pattern for get/detail command (printTicketDetail function for formatted console output, JSON mode). 125 lines.
Shared HTTP client (`hxFetch`) used for all API calls. Supports GET/POST/PATCH, retry logic, basePath override (use `/api` not default `/api/inspect`). 135 lines.
Shared flag-parsing utilities: getFlag, hasFlag, requireFlag, isHelpRequested. All new commands should use these. 36 lines.
HxConfig type definition. All run* functions receive this as first argument. Defines apiKey, url, orgId fields.
Repository name/ID resolution utilities. `resolveAllRepos` resolves comma-separated repo names to IDs. Needed for `hlx goals create --repos`.
CLI documentation content exported as `cliDocsContent`. Must be updated to include `hlx goals` namespace documentation alongside existing commands. 350 lines.

Build/typecheck/test scripts. Zero runtime deps (devDeps only: @types/node, typescript). Build: `tsc`, Typecheck: `tsc --noEmit`, Test: `tsc && node --test dist/**/*.test.js`. ES module (`type: module`). v1.3.4.
TypeScript config: strict mode, ES2022 target, Node16 modules, rootDir=src, outDir=dist, declaration=true.

facts: No src/goals/ directory exists yet -- must be created from scratch.

Server-side Goal API endpoints are fully implemented at /api/goals (11 endpoints registered in api.ts:436-447): POST, GET list, GET :id, PATCH :id, POST :id/terminate, GET :id/evaluations, GET :id/evaluations/:evalId, POST :id/evaluations/:evalId/approve, POST :id/evaluations/:evalId/reject, GET :id/roadmap, GET :id/previews.

Goal controller (goal-controller.ts) uses Zod schemas: CreateGoalSchema accepts title, description, maxChildren, requireApproval, repositoryIds, sprintId. TerminateGoalSchema requires verdict: 'complete' | 'failed'.
Server responses wrap in `{ goal }` for single objects and `{ items }` for lists -- matching tickets pattern.
GET /api/goals/:id returns { goal } with `latestEvaluation` (transformed from evaluations array, line 84-85 of goal-controller.ts).
GoalStatus enum has 9 values: DRAFT, QUEUED, RUNNING, ACTIVE, EVALUATING, PENDING_APPROVAL, PAUSED, COMPLETED, FAILED (prisma/schema.prisma:155-165).
VALID_MODES in src/tickets/create.ts (line 13) is ['AUTO', 'BUILD', 'FIX', 'RESEARCH', 'EXECUTE'] and must NOT be modified.
Command registration pattern: top-level switch in src/index.ts calls `run<Namespace>(config, args.slice(1))`. Each namespace has index.ts exporting `run<Namespace>` that routes subcommands.
hxFetch requires basePath: '/api' for goals endpoints (default basePath is '/api/inspect').
CLI has zero runtime dependencies -- only devDependencies (@types/node, typescript).
Module system: ES modules (package.json type=module, .js extensions required in imports).
T7 spec requires exactly 4 commands: create, list, get, terminate. Plus command registration in index.ts and documentation in cli-content.ts.
GET /api/goals supports optional ?status query parameter for filtering.
hxFetch returns parsed JSON (response.json()). Callers cast with `as SomeType`.
The cli-content.ts exports via package.json `exports` field (./docs) for external documentation systems.
